status_note: Seven bounded Wave D PMP_Remeshing adapters (triangulate_faces/triangulate_face, refine, isotropic_remeshing, split_long_edges, tangential_relaxation, smooth_shape, Adaptive_sizing_field remeshing) and seven mandatory independent validators are VALIDATED in the formal official-CGAL 6.2.1 worker and the MCP auto/legacy publication paths. They were verified by the repository's own cases and MCP end-to-end tests and have not had a separate independent native review. Other PMP_Remeshing entry points (fair, angle_and_area_smoothing, surface Delaunay/ACVD remeshing, planar-patch remeshing, refine_with_plane, isolevel refinement) remain unimplemented.
